lines: We need water to produce our food and manufacture products.
For example, about 265 gallons of water is needed to produce two pounds of wheat.
Thus, the virtual water of these two pounds of wheat is 265 gallons.
Virtual water is also present in dairy products, soups, and beverages.
Every day, humans use lots of virtual water, and the amount of virtual water varies depending on the product.
For instance, it takes more water to produce meat than to produce the same amount of vegetables.
body.text: We need water to produce our food and manufacture products. We call this “virtual water.” For example, about 265 gallons of water is needed to produce two pounds of wheat. Thus, the virtual water of these two pounds of wheat is 265 gallons. Virtual water is also present in dairy products, soups, and beverages. Every day, humans use lots of virtual water, and the amount of virtual water varies depending on the product. For instance, it takes more water to produce meat than to produce the same amount of vegetables.
